title: The notification centre inbox surfaces the last N days of notifications and every acknowledge control round-trips to the server
asA: keyboard-only operator using a shipped rcf-lite application
iWant: to reach every notification in the centre with Tab, mark items read, mark all read, and acknowledge each item with an activation that round-trips to the server and updates the item on the response
soThat: I have a durable record of what the shell has said and my acknowledgement is recorded server-side rather than lost on a page reload

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the notification centre route with a seeded backlog of notifications, the surface lists every notification delivered within the ADR-2103 retention window (thirty days by default). Each notification carries `data-notification-id` on its wrapper element (pack enumerates by that per-element attribute, never by `role="listitem"` on the container alone); each carries a Tab-reachable acknowledge control `[data-action="acknowledge"]` and a Tab-reachable mark-read control `[data-action="mark-read"]`; the surface carries exactly one mark-all-read control `[data-action="mark-all-read"]`. Activating a per-item acknowledge control POSTs `POST /api/notifications/acknowledge` (recorded on `window.__notificationFetches` and at `GET /__requests`), the server responds `200 { ok: true }`, and the item's `data-acknowledged` reads `true` after the response.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the notification centre with a seeded backlog
acceptanceCriteria.when: an acknowledge control is activated by keyboard
acceptanceCriteria.then: the acknowledge round-trips to the server and the DOM updates in response

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the centre factory (TAC-2102 `renderCentre`), the factory reads the delivery-attempt log from REQ-005's endpoint and emits one wrapper per row within the retention window; a factory that emits rows older than the retention window, or that skips rows within the window, fails at project-side review.
acceptanceCriteria.then: one wrapper is emitted per row within the retention window
